issues.suggestion: Optionally use \boldmath or \mathbf{A} etc. inside the node, or increase the label font size slightly, to match the heavier label weight. Keep the current node anchors.

issues.suggestion: Optionally raise line width marginally (e.g. from 1.4pt to about 1.5pt). This is not required for fidelity.
